lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, displaying a geometric spacing of approximately 30-50 pixels between local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (~15% higher luminance than the base flank) intersect the high-luminance blobs at near-perpendicular angles, forming a structured matrix pattern across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal aspect and deep shadows on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin displays a high density of small, high-luminance spots concentrated towards the distal edge and anterior margin, significantly more clustered than the primary lateral flank patterning.
